browserSession.description: Live browser sessions require explicit browser_sessions policy and a dedicated trusted HTTPS hostname. Secure, HttpOnly, host-only, Path=/, SameSite=Strict with Origin and CSRF checks. Cookies are not port-isolated. Demo uses bridge_demo_session_v2; CLI-only live listeners refuse browser login.
